dashboard.title: Accounts
dashboard.intro: Claude Code always uses the first available account. Drag to reorder; the next one takes over when a limit is reached.
dashboard.loadFailedHint: The claude-swap server did not answer. It may be stopped or restarting.
dashboard.unknownLogin: Claude Code is logged in as {email}, which isn't in your list. Import it so claude-swap can manage it.
dashboard.engineErrorUnknown: No details were recorded. See the server log.
dashboard.emptyHint: Log in with Claude Code, then import the account here. Add several and they'll take turns as limits run out.

stats.label: Summary
stats.swapsHint: {count, plural, =0 {No swaps} one {# automatic or manual swap} other {# automatic or manual swaps}}
stats.modeAutoHint: Swaps when a limit is reached

chart.title: Usage over time
chart.empty: No usage recorded yet. Points appear after the first checks.

dnd.instructions: To reorder, press space or enter on the handle, use the up and down arrow keys to move, then press space or enter again to drop. Press escape to cancel.
dnd.canceled: Reordering canceled. {name} is back at position {position}.

errors.rolledBack: Your last change was undone. Try again.
errors.importFailed: Couldn't import the current Claude Code login

addAccount.intro: claude-swap copies the account Claude Code is logged in with right now. To add another one:
addAccount.step2: Type /login and sign in with the account you want to add.
addAccount.step3: Come back here and import it.
addAccount.logoutHint: Logging out can revoke the login claude-swap keeps for that account. /login switches accounts safely.
addAccount.notLoggedIn: Claude Code isn't logged in. Run /login first.
addAccount.readFailed: Couldn't read Claude Code's login files.
addAccount.known: In your list: importing refreshes its login
addAccount.label: Name (optional)
addAccount.labelHint: Shown in the list. Leave empty to use the account name.

settings.autoRotateHint: Off keeps Claude Code on the top account until you change the order.
settings.thresholdHint: Swap away once usage reaches this share of the window.
settings.thresholdError: Enter a whole number from 50 to 100.
settings.pollIntervalHint: How often usage is fetched for each account.
settings.pollIntervalError: Enter a whole number from 60 to 3600.

removeAccount.confirm: {name} and its saved login will be removed from claude-swap. Claude Code itself isn't logged out.
removeAccount.activeTitle: Claude Code is using this account
removeAccount.activeHint: claude-swap will switch Claude Code to the next available account.
removeAccount.missing: This account isn't in your list anymore.
